verdict.rationale: AgentMail is API-first: inboxes are created, managed and operated entirely via API and SDKs. It also ships a CLI as a single native binary with no runtime dependencies, and agents can self-register to get an API key, so it runs headlessly without a UI. The CI side is implied rather than shown. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD documentation (e.g., GitHub Actions examples, environment-variable auth, non-interactive CLI flags), independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Create, manage, and operate email inboxes entirely via API.
It ships as a single native binary with no runtime dependencies.
The agent registers itself using an email you provide and receives an API key in response.
